result.title: Latent space configuration for neural network finetuning, fast ranking, and embedding dimensionality reduction
result.summary: Finding K most similar elements for a query in a large gallery of neural network (NN) embeddings is essential in various areas of computer science and industrial applications of artificial intelligence. This paper proposes search algorithms for structured latent spaces (LS) of NNs which allow to speed up top K item retrieval owing to O(1) complexity small candidate gallery subset search. ArcFace-pretrained IResNet50 models are finetuned using Latent Space Configuration (LSC) methodology to obtain new distribution of embeddings with desired geometric properties. Applying the proposed algorithms to embeddings obtained from finetuned models leads to several times speed-up over baseline exhaustive search. Specifically, we report up to 3 times speed-up on GPU and 40% speed-up on CPU compared to the baseline method GPU speed. These results are obtained for the original and reduced numbers of LS dimensions. The results show that LS dimensionality reduction allows to further accelerate the search and even improve rank-N metrics.

AI.brief_summary: 用 Latent Space Configuration 方法微调 ArcFace 预训练的 IResNet50，使嵌入呈现便于检索的结构化几何分布，并设计只需 O(1) 规模候选子集搜索的 top-K 算法，实现 GPU/CPU 加速，同时考察嵌入降维对速度与 rank-N 指标的影响。
AI.relevance_reason: 通过改造 latent 空间几何换取检索效率，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与候选剪枝的表示组织有概念联系，但该文面向人脸检索而非多模态推理，迁移价值需核查。
